name: openalex-mcp-server
description: Access the OpenAlex academic research catalog - 270M+ publications through MCP. STDIO & Streamable HTTP.

OPENALEX_API_KEY.title: OpenAlex API key
OPENALEX_API_KEY.description: Optional. OpenAlex account key (free from openalex.org/settings/api), sent as api_key= for keyed rate limits. Leave blank for anonymous access.

OPENALEX_MAILTO.title: OpenAlex Mailto
OPENALEX_MAILTO.description: Optional email sent as mailto= to identify yourself to OpenAlex (the polite pool). Separate from the API key.

MCP_LOG_LEVEL.title: Log Level
MCP_LOG_LEVEL.description: Minimum log level (debug, info, notice, warning, error, crit, alert, emerg).
